args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) began failing health checks with an 18% error rate shortly after deployment. Mitigation: rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification: service healthy in all regions, error rate reduced to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, suggesting the issue was detectable pre-production.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0
